project.name: Kovac dual occupancy, 18 Wattlebird Street
project.summary: Demolition of a 1958 single-storey brick house and construction of an attached dual occupancy (two two-storey, four-bedroom townhouses, 460 m2 GFA in total, each with an attached garage, own driveway and crossing) with Torrens title subdivision into proposed Lots 1 and 2, on a 700 m2 R2 lot in Carlingford. One DA to the City of Parramatta, on-site detention required by council, architect-led tender to residential builders under an HIA lump-sum contract; budget $1,650,000 ex GST.
